lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in four distinct horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits. The centroids follow a non-linear grid distribution with higher spatial density in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary circular blobs, forming a lattice of grid-like anchor nodes along the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature along the dorsal-lateral boundary characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with high-intensity pixels on the superior edge and shadowing immediately below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Several small, reddish-brown circular anomalies are visible on the mid-lateral flank posterior to the fifth gill slit, indicating potential parasitic lesions or localized trauma.
